name: LED bit-map diagnostic
description: Diagnostic only. Forces three known bits (28, 40, 51) on in the live 56-bit LED bitmap (0x20001E7B) every scan cycle, without touching anything else. Flash this alone (untick the polyphony mod), note which physical keys light, then report them. Used to derive the note/key to bit mapping; not for musical use.

patches.note: force diagnostic bits before the SPI shift-out (reproduces r1/r0 loads)
